data.name: Latifah
data.gender_notes: Latifah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Gentle and soft in manner, having a refined and sophisticated character. The name Latifah carries the meaning “Delicate, tender, subtle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Latifah usually hope their child will grow to embody delicate, tender, subtle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the gentle touch and care of Allah (swt) towards His creation.
data.etymology: Latifah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delicate, tender, subtle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Latifah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: لطيفة
in_arabic.meaning: لطيفة تعني اللطف و الجمال و الرقة
in_arabic.long_meaning: لطيفة هي اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل 'لطف' الذي يعني التكرم و الإحسان. وصف الله نفسه في القرآن الكريم باللطف، قال تعالى: 'والله يقبض ويبسط' (البقرة: 245)، و 'لطف الله على رسوله' (التوبة: 61). يعني الاسم الرقة و اللطف في التعامل و الإحساس، و هو من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: لطیفہ
in_urdu.meaning: لطیفہ یعنی خوبصورتی، ملائمت، اور خوبی
in_urdu.long_meaning: لطیفہ ایک عربی मूल کا اسم ہے، جو 'لطف' فعل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مہربانی اور احسان۔ اسلامی تقویم میں، اللہ تعالیٰ نے اپنے لطف کو قرآن کریم میں بیان کیا ہے، جیسے کہ 'والله يقبض ويبسط' (البقرة: 245) اور 'لطف الله على رسوله' (التوبة: 61)۔ یہ نام حسن خلق، مہربانی، اور خوبی کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، جو اسلامی ثقافت میں ایک اہم قدرتی صفت ہے

in_hindi.name: लतीफा
in_hindi.meaning: लतीफा का अर्थ है सौंदर्य, मृदुता और कोमलता
in_hindi.long_meaning: लतीफा एक अरबी मूल का नाम है, जो 'लतफ' क्रिया से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है दया और कृपा। इस्लामी परंपरा में, अल्लाह की दया और कृपा को قرآن कریم में वर्णित किया गया है, जैसे कि 'والله يقبض ويبسط' (अल-बक़रा: 245) और 'لطف الله على رسوله' (अत-तौबा: 61)। यह नाम अच्छे चरित्र, दया और सौंदर्य को दर्शाता है, जो इस्लामी संस्कृति में एक महत्वपूर्ण प्राकृतिक गुण है

in_pashto.name: لطيفه
in_pashto.meaning: لطيفه د ښکلا، نرمي او مينه معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: لطيفه د عربي اصل نوم دی، چی د 'لطف' کلمې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چی د مهربانۍ او احسان معنی ورکوي. په اسلامي کلیتور کی، الله تعالیٰ خپله مهرباني په قرآن کریم کی بيان کړې ده، لکه 'والله يقبض ويبسط' (البقرة: 245) او 'لطف الله على رسوله' (التوبة: 61)۔ دا نوم د ښکلا، مينه، او نرمي څرګندوي، چی په اسلامي کلیتور کی يو مهم طبيعي ځانګړتیا ده

in_english.name: Latifah
in_english.meaning: Meaning beauty, gentleness, kindness, and courtesy
in_english.long_meaning: Latifah is an Arabic-originated name derived from the verb 'latf', meaning kindness and benevolence. In Islamic tradition, Allah's mercy and kindness are expressed in the Quran, such as 'And Allah constricts and expands' (Al-Baqara: 245) and 'The mercy of Allah on His Messenger' (At-Tawbah: 61). The name signifies good character, gentleness, and beauty, which are essential natural attributes in Islamic culture

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: لطيفه

data.cultural_impact: The name Latifah is an elegant and beautiful name in the Islamic culture. It is a name that reflects a woman who is gentle, kind, and courteous in her demeanor. In various parts of the Islamic world, this name is cherished for its noble connotations and is often given to girls as a sign of hope and love.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Latifah is a reminder of Allah's mercy and compassion towards His creatures. It is believed that Allah is Latif, meaning He is the Most Gentle and Lenient, and that He Showers His blessings upon us with kindness and gentleness. Therefore, the name Latifah is a constant reminder for a Muslim to be kind, compassionate, and gentle in their dealings with others, reflecting the attributes of Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Delicate, tender, subtle" symbolizes Gentle and soft in manner, having a refined and sophisticated character.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Latifah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of delicate, tender, subtle.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Latifah bint Abdullah ibn Ja'far was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and is known for her generosity and kindness.
